shippingDeductedFromPayout.note: Mexico is not listed by name; "All Other Markets" is $30 USD

fees.shippingNote: Per single item; prepaid label provided; deducted from the payout.

marketplaces.note: Seller Level is measured on quarterly sales. StockX has run limited-time 0% processing promotions (stockx.com/news/seller-payment-processing-fees/), not reflected here. A failed-verification penalty fee exists, but the help page read gives no amount ("Penalty fee details can be found in ... your Payout Statement"); a search summary put it at $15, unconfirmed, so it is left null.

fees.processingFeeRule: dynamic: based on item price, location and market conditions; fixed once an offer is placed
fees.shippingRule: not fixed: set by item price, size, type, carrier rates and destination; shown before purchase
fees.taxes: import duties and sales tax by shipping address

fees.sellerNote: no standard selling, processing or shipping fees; seller keeps the sale price less any penalty or return-related fees
fees.buyerShipping: by item size, weight and category

marketplaces.rule: An item bought new on the Verified Marketplace, delivered after 10 July 2024, still in its delivered condition with the StockX tag, and resold within 90 days of delivery pays no transaction, processing or shipping fee. Not for items sent to Flex or Store at StockX.

conditions.verifiedMarketplace: Sneakers must be brand new and include the original box, free from signs of use, damage or tampering. StockX also sells "B-Grade" items.
listingsMarketplace: New: unworn, no signs of wear; original packaging where applicable
New - Other: unworn, no signs of wear; original tags or accessories may be missing and flaws may be present

marketplaces.authentication: A Verified Marketplace item ships from the seller to a StockX Verification Center (unless it comes from a StockX Verified Seller), where it is inspected against StockX condition guidelines, including its box and accessories, then shipped on to the buyer; typically 1-2 business days after arrival. An item that fails is generally returned to the seller and a penalty fee charged; counterfeits may be turned over to authorities. Listings Marketplace items are verified only if the buyer pays the $12.50 option.

fees.ratingRule: All sellers start at 90; each seller cancellation costs 10 points, each successful sale adds 2.
fees.cashOutNote: ACH direct deposit or PayPal; cash-out allowed once earnings exceed $25.

cancellationFee.note: confirmed order cancelled, or not shipped within 3 business days

inactiveAccountFee.note: after two years without activity, in listed US states only

marketplaces.note: All GOAT fees are in US dollars. Selling from outside the US is "only available to select sellers". Commission and seller fee come off the listing price.

fees.taxes: Sales tax or VAT by shipping address; non-US buyers pay their own duties.
fees.returnRefund: GOAT Credit, less shipping both ways and any priority fee; a return processing fee of up to 15% of the item price may apply
fees.notReturnable: used items, Defect, Pre-Release, Final Sale, Vintage, Sample, auction and GOAT Storage items

goatCleanGrades: Like New: minimal to no signs of wear
Excellent: slight wear on tread with minimal creasing
Very Good: gentle wear with some creasing, scratches and/or slight discoloration
Good: moderate wear with visible creasing, scuffing and/or discoloration
conditions.listingRule: The seller lists by SKU and enters the condition; used or new-with-defects items need photos. The item must ship in the condition listed.

marketplaces.authentication: Most items ship from the seller to GOAT for review before going to the buyer (7-12 business days to a US buyer). GOAT verifies "by a variety of means, such as digital authentication, in-hand verification, and/or machine learning technology", and says some products are verified without physical examination. An item found inauthentic or not as described: GOAT supplies the same item or a full refund, at its option.

luxuryResale.rules: Listing is free; the selling fee and the payment processing fee come off the sale price. Fees include VAT/GST/US sales tax where applicable. The text gives processing as "3% (min $3 / £3 / 4 CAD)"; the table shows that minimum as a fixed fee in the lowest band. Vestiaire may change the structure within the cap in its Seller T&Cs.
luxuryResale.note: The EUR band (17%, €75-€15,000) was read from the fee-table image on the page; GBP, USD and CAD are also in the article text. The image draws the bands as "[€0 - €75]", "[€75 - €15 000]", "[€15 000 +]", so which band a price exactly on a boundary falls in is not stated.

luxuryResale.model: consignment (TRR prices and sells; the consignor is paid a commission)

rules.commission: Net Selling Price x the applicable Commission Rate from therealreal.com/commission-chart. Net Selling Price is the sold price less discounts and promotions, excluding taxes and shipping.
rules.tierBasis: The rate depends on the consignor's Net Sales within a one-year Commission Window; each new window starts at the highest rate reached in the previous one.
rules.discount: TRR may apply an immediate 20% discount to an item's initial sale price unless agreed otherwise.
rules.payment: Processed from the 15th of each month for the previous month's sales; a paper cheque may carry a processing fee.
rules.headline: "Receive up to 85% of each item's sale price."

luxuryResale.note: The band-by-band chart is at https://www.therealreal.com/commission-chart, which refused every request (HTTP 403, a bot wall), and the Wayback Machine has no copy since 2020. Left null rather than filled from secondary blogs, which disagree with each other (e.g. "20% under $100", "45% for $150-$199", "70% for handbags $1,500-$4,999", "up to 85% on watches over $7,500"). The consignor terms were read from the Wayback copy of 1 May 2026, since the live page also refused.

notes: Read on 2026-10-02. Prices are numbers in the major unit of the stated currency.

taxIncluded: Nike, JD Sports and Foot Locker prices in Britain and Ireland include VAT (Foot Locker UK says "VAT included"). Nike US and Nike Canada prices are before sales tax/GST/HST. Mexican prices are taken as IVA-inclusive because Mexico's consumer law (Ley Federal de Protección al Consumidor, art. 7 Bis) requires the total price, taxes included, to be shown; Nike MX's page does not say so itself.

Sizes are given only where the product page itself was read. Nike US/CA show M/W pairs (women's = men's + 1.5); Nike UK shows UK sizes with EU equivalents; Nike MX shows CM. JD Sports and Foot Locker lists are the sizes their pages offered that day, so they reflect stock. Null means the price came from a category grid.

Release dates come from sneaker press (sneakernews, sneakerbardetroit, SI, Sneaker Shouts) or Nike SNKRS launch pages; ones read only through a search summary say so. Nike product pages show no release date apart from SNKRS launch pages and "Available" notices.
Nike US showed IQ5495-005 (AJ1 High Royal), CK9246-200 (AJ3 Fireside) and HV6474-601 (AJ41) as sold out before their release dates; the price is Nike's, the availability is not.

Couldn't read: Foot Locker US and Canada (HTTP 400), Finish Line (403), Innvictus Mexico (403), StockX product pages (no market data in the fetched page; 403 to direct requests). So StockX figures are SI FanNation's reported averages, not last sales by size, and StockX UK prices weren't obtained at all. GOAT has no GBP data: its data for country GB still comes back in USD, with different asks, so no UK resale figure is given.

GOAT figures are listing prices before the buyer's shipping ($14.95 US standard) and tax. A null lastSale means GOAT showed no sale for that size. The reference size is US men's 10, or US women's 8 for women's shoes. Pre-release asks (AJ41, Tatum 5) are speculative, not market value.

Style-code caveats: GOAT lists the AJ4 'Comic' under IO2362-100 (Nike: JA1135-100). GOAT maps CK9246-101 to an older AJ3 'Orange Citrus' (Nike UK: Sport Renaissance), so no resale is given for it. GOAT's retail field differs from Nike's price for several shoes, so it is kept separately as goatListedRetail.

On the date read, most 2026 general-release retros (True Blue, Laser AJ3, Tour Yellow, Comic, Love Letter, Flight Club AJ1 and AJ4, AJ11 Low University Blue, World's Best, White Metallic, Flint, Oreo, Toro Bravo, Garden) traded below retail on GOAT, and SI reports the same on StockX. Collaborations and limited launches traded above: J Balvin AJ4, Howard AJ1 Low (asks only), Halloween AJ5 and Royal AJ1 High (pre-release), and Black Carolina AJ5 just above.
